During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a '''medic''' served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] was engaged to fellow medic, [[Kral (Alliance)|Kral]], and served in a battle against [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces under the command of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Reese (Alliance)|Reese]].
